description: CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE used by the host, pad and bootloader frames: the published check value, the empty input, single bytes, and the low-byte-first storage rule with frame examples.

cases.description: Published check value: CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE of ASCII 123456789 is 0x29B1 (the FDT test asserts the same value)
Empty input returns the initial value 0xFFFF
One byte 00: the initial value is XORed into the high byte, then eight shifts with polynomial 0x1021
One byte ff, same routine as the 00 case
Stored low byte first: the GET_STATUS body 00 00 22 has CRC 0xC8BC and goes on the wire as bcc8
The version probe as captured in the 2026-09-25 identification TX records: body 00 00 23, CRC 0xD89D stored as 9dd8
